chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 174: Danyangzi's Ascension & The Ox-Head Gate
chapter_meta_description: Danyangzi achieves his lifelong dream of ascension, only to find the celestial gate is not what he expected. A masterful chapter of cosmic horror and shattering revelations.
og_title: The Southern Gate Was a Lie
og_description: Danyangzi's final, triumphant journey through the cosmos ends at a door that refuses to open. The brutal payoff to a hundred chapters of body horror.
twitter_title: He Made It. It Wasn't Heaven.
twitter_description: Danyangzi reaches the Southern Heavenly Gate. The name on the door is different. A perfect, heart-stopping twist.
